notes: Solar Flats is a complete 3-lap 3D desert time trial against a ghost rival, with checkpoint-gated laps, chase/hood cameras, touch controls, a minimap and persisted best times. It loads Three.js from a CDN, so an internet connection is needed on first load. Verified in a browser via DOM and console checks (start, countdown, timer, HUD, pause, restart, camera and sound); screenshots were unavailable in that environment and a full 3-lap drive was not completed there.
